General.description: Animation, pointer behavior, Space activation, hot reload, and dragging tiled windows.

Layouts.description: Choose a default layout and tune spacing, insertion, and layout-specific behavior.

Scrolling layout.description: Settings for the scrolling-column layout and its optional trackpad gestures.
Scrolling layout.next: See [Scrolling](/rift-docs/layouts/scrolling/) for column navigation and multiple-display limitations.

Gestures.description: Trackpad swipes between virtual workspaces. Disabled by default.
Gestures.next: On Scrolling workspaces, Rift uses the separate [column gesture settings](/rift-docs/reference/configuration/scrolling/).

User interface.description: Optional indicators for the menu bar, stack line, and Mission Control.
User interface.next: All three features are disabled by default.

App rules.description: Match windows and control their placement, size, focus, or management.
App rules.next: The [App rules guide](/rift-docs/guides/app-rules/) explains matching and which rule wins.

Virtual workspaces.description: Workspace count, names, focus behavior, and rules for assigning windows to workspaces.
Virtual workspaces.next: See [Virtual workspaces](/rift-docs/guides/workspaces/) for the difference from macOS Spaces and how to navigate them.

Keybindings.description: Assign keyboard shortcuts to Rift commands in the `[keys]` table.
Keybindings.next: Your `[keys]` table replaces the bundled keymap; an empty table registers no shortcuts.

Modifier combinations.description: Name a combination of modifier keys, such as Option + Shift, and reuse it in shortcuts.
Modifier combinations.next: Use spaces around `+` when referencing a name: `main + H`.

Commands and startup.description: Launch helper programs when Rift starts.

keys.description: A map whose keys are hotkey strings and whose values are Rift commands. This table replaces the bundled keymap; it is not merged. An empty map registers no keyboard shortcuts.

modifier_combinations.description: A map from a short name to a modifier string. For example, `main = "Alt + Shift"` lets you write `main + H` in the `[keys]` table.

settings.description: Global behavior shared by the active layout and the rest of Rift.

settings.animate.description: Animate layout changes and focus transitions. Keep this off while troubleshooting layout behavior.

settings.animation_duration.description: Animation duration in seconds when `animate` is enabled. Must not be negative.

settings.animation_fps.description: Target animation frame rate. Higher values look smoother but use more CPU. Must be greater than zero.

settings.animation_easing.description: Curve used to accelerate and decelerate animations.

settings.default_disable.description: Start each newly encountered macOS Space inactive. Press your activation key before Rift manages it.

settings.mouse_follows_focus.description: Allow Rift to move the pointer with keyboard-driven focus and workspace changes.

settings.mouse_hides_on_focus.description: Hide the pointer after Rift changes the focused window. Rift also hides it after a pointer warp when `mouse_follows_focus` is enabled.

settings.focus_follows_mouse.description: Ask Rift to focus a managed window when the pointer moves over it.

settings.focus_follows_mouse_disable_hot.description: Optional hotkey held to temporarily suspend focus-follows-mouse. Use a full hotkey such as `Ctrl + A` or a modifier such as `Ctrl`.

settings.auto_focus_blacklist.description: Bundle identifiers that should not cause Rift to switch workspaces when those applications become active, such as Spotlight.

settings.hot_reload.description: Reload the config file when it changes. Even when this is false, Rift watches for keymap changes and reloads when the parsed bindings differ.

settings.layout.description: Choose the default layout and set options shared by every layout. A layout-specific table can override a shared option.

settings.layout.window_insertion_point.description: Where Rift inserts a newly managed window. A layout-specific value wins; if neither value is set, Rift uses `next_to_selection`.

settings.layout.mode.description: Layout used for a workspace that does not match a `virtual_workspaces.workspace_rules` entry.

settings.layout.traditional.description: Options specific to the Traditional tree layout.

settings.layout.traditional.window_inser.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Traditional. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

settings.layout.bsp.description: Options specific to the BSP layout. Shared layout settings can still be set here.

settings.layout.bsp.window_insertion_poi.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for BSP. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

settings.layout.stack.description: Options specific to the Stack layout.

settings.layout.stack.window_insertion_p.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Stack. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

settings.layout.stack.stack_offset.description: Number of pixels by which each window is offset from the previous window in a stack. Must not be negative.

settings.layout.stack.default_orientatio.description: Direction of a new stack. `perpendicular` uses the axis across its parent, `same` uses the parent's axis, and `horizontal` or `vertical` forces an axis.

settings.layout.master_stack.description: Options specific to the Master-stack layout.

settings.layout.master_stack.window_inse.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Master-stack. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

settings.layout.gaps.description: Space between tiled windows and the screen edges, plus space between neighboring windows.

settings.layout.gaps.outer.description: Insets between the tiled area and each edge of the display. Gap values must not be negative.

settings.layout.gaps.inner.description: Space between neighboring tiled windows. Gap values must not be negative.

settings.layout.gaps.per_display.description: Optional display-specific gap overrides keyed by display UUID. An override replaces the complete outer or inner gap group for that display.
settings.layout.gaps.per_display.note: Run `rift-cli query displays` and replace `YOUR-DISPLAY-UUID` with the display UUID. Set any of `top`, `bottom`, `left`, and `right` in an `outer` table, or `horizontal` and `vertical` in an `inner` table. Omitted values within an overridden group become `0`; omitting the entire group inherits the global group.

settings.layout.master_stack.master_rati.description: Fraction of the tiling area reserved for the master side. Valid range: `0.05` through `0.95`.

settings.layout.master_stack.master_coun.description: Number of windows kept on the master side. Must be at least `1`.

settings.layout.master_stack.master_side.description: Edge occupied by the master side: `left`, `right`, `top`, or `bottom`.

settings.layout.master_stack.new_window_.description: Where to insert a new window after the master area is full. `master` puts it in the main area and moves an existing window to the stack; `stack` keeps it in the supporting area; `focused` uses the focused area. Rift maintains `master_count`.

settings.layout.master_stack.master_arra.description: Optional direction used to divide multiple windows inside the master side. When omitted, Rift uses the direction perpendicular to the master/stack split.

settings.layout.master_stack.stack_arran.description: Optional direction used to divide windows inside the stack side. When omitted, Rift uses the direction perpendicular to the master/stack split.

settings.layout.scrolling.description: Options specific to the Scrolling layout.

settings.layout.scrolling.window_inserti.description: Override the layout-wide insertion point for Scrolling. Leave it unset to inherit `[settings.layout].window_insertion_point`.

settings.layout.scrolling.animate.description: Override animation only for Scrolling workspaces. Leave it unset to inherit `settings.animate`.

settings.layout.scrolling.column_width_r.description: Normal width of a column as a fraction of the tiling area. It must stay between `min_column_width_ratio` and `max_column_width_ratio`.

settings.layout.scrolling.min_column_wid.description: Smallest column width allowed by resize commands, from `0.0` through `1.0`.

settings.layout.scrolling.max_column_wid.description: Largest column width allowed by resize commands, from `0.0` through `1.0`.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.description: Optional horizontal gestures for moving between columns in a Scrolling workspace. The finger count is configurable.

settings.gestures.description: Optional horizontal gestures for switching virtual workspaces. The finger count is configurable.

settings.window_snapping.description: Mouse-drag behavior for swapping tiled windows.

settings.window_snapping.drag_swap_fract.description: Overlap needed to select a drag-swap target. Rift divides the intersection area by the union area of the two windows. Lower values make swaps easier to trigger.
settings.window_snapping.drag_swap_fract.note: If `[settings.window_snapping]` is omitted entirely, this starts at `0.0`. Set it explicitly for predictable behavior.

settings.run_on_start.description: Command lines to run once Rift starts. Rift splits quoted arguments and launches the executable directly; use `sh -c` explicitly when shell syntax is required.
settings.run_on_start.note: Reloading does not run these entries again. Restart Rift after changing startup commands. Commands launch independently, so do not rely on list order to wait for another helper.

settings.ui.description: Optional visual indicators. All UI helpers are disabled by default.

settings.ui.menu_bar.description: Show workspace status in the macOS menu bar.

settings.ui.menu_bar.enabled.description: Enable the menu bar workspace indicator.

settings.ui.menu_bar.show_empty.description: Include workspaces that currently have no windows.

settings.ui.menu_bar.mode.description: Show every workspace or only the active one.

settings.ui.menu_bar.active_label.description: Label a workspace with its one-based workspace number or its configured name.

settings.ui.menu_bar.display_style.description: Draw a miniature representation of each workspace’s windows (`layout`) or show a number or name (`label`).

settings.ui.menu_bar.layout_folder.description: Folder containing saved `.ron` layouts shown in the menu bar’s restore menus. `~` expands to your home directory.

settings.ui.stack_line.description: Show a small edge indicator for stacked windows.

settings.ui.stack_line.hover.description: Choose whether the indicator responds to a click or pointer hover.

settings.ui.stack_line.thickness.description: Thickness of the stack-line indicator in points.
settings.ui.stack_line.thickness.note: Omitting the entire containing table gives `0` instead.

settings.ui.stack_line.horiz_placement.description: Place the stack line at the top or bottom edge of the window.

settings.ui.stack_line.vert_placement.description: Place the stack line at the left or right edge of the window.

settings.ui.mission_control.description: Rift’s own Mission Control-style workspace overview.

settings.ui.mission_control.fade_enabled.description: Fade managed windows during Mission Control transitions.

settings.ui.mission_control.fade_duratio.note: Omitting the entire containing table gives `0` instead.

virtual_workspaces.description: Rift’s named or numbered work areas. A workspace is a logical layer on top of a macOS Space.

virtual_workspaces.default_workspace_cou.description: Number of virtual workspaces to create by default. Must be at least 1 and no more than 128.

virtual_workspaces.workspace_auto_back_a.description: Switching to the workspace you are already on returns to the previously active workspace.

virtual_workspaces.prevent_wrapping.description: Stop at the first and last workspace instead of wrapping around.

virtual_workspaces.workspace_names.description: Names for workspaces in index order. Names make app and workspace rules easier to read; the list cannot be longer than `default_workspace_count`.

virtual_workspaces.default_workspace.description: Zero-based workspace selected when a new macOS Space is first managed. It must be less than `default_workspace_count`.

virtual_workspaces.reapply_app_rules_on_.description: Re-check title-based app rules when a window title changes. Useful for apps that finish naming a window after launch, but it can move a window again later.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.description: One rule per `[[virtual_workspaces.app_rules]]` entry. Match fields are combined with AND; the most specific matching rule wins.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.position.description: Initial normalized position for a floating window. Both `x` and `y` are between `0.0` and `1.0`; position is only valid when `floating = true`.
virtual_workspaces.app_rules.position.example:
[[virtual_workspaces.app_rules]]
app_id = "com.apple.Calculator"
floating = true
position = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.position.x.description: Horizontal position: `0.0` is the left edge and `1.0` is the right edge.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.position.y.description: Vertical position: `0.0` is the top edge and `1.0` is the bottom edge.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.size.description: Initial size in logical pixels. Set `w`, `h`, or both; this is applied once when the rule matches.
virtual_workspaces.app_rules.size.example:
[[virtual_workspaces.app_rules]]
app_id = "com.apple.Calculator"
floating = true
size = { w = 420.0, h = 680.0 }

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.size.w.description: Initial width in logical pixels. Must be positive when provided.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.size.h.description: Initial height in logical pixels. Must be positive when provided.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.app_name.description: Case-insensitive containment match against the app name. Rift matches when the rule contains the app name or the app name contains the rule. Prefer `app_id` for an exact application match.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.title_regex.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the window title. Use `title_substring` when you do not need a pattern.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.title_subst.description: Case-insensitive text matched anywhere in the window title.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.ax_role.description: Exact macOS Accessibility role, such as `AXWindow`. Useful when an app creates several kinds of windows.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.ax_subrole.description: Exact macOS Accessibility subrole, such as `AXDialog`, to distinguish dialogs from normal windows.

virtual_workspaces.workspace_rules.description: Rules that select a layout for a workspace by name or zero-based index.

virtual_workspaces.workspace_rules.works.description: Workspace name or zero-based index to match.

virtual_workspaces.workspace_rules.layou.description: Layout to use in the matching workspace.

settings.gestures.enabled.description: Enable horizontal trackpad swipes for switching virtual workspaces.

settings.gestures.consume_dock_swipe.description: Prevent macOS or the foreground app from also handling a swipe Rift consumed.

settings.gestures.invert_horizontal_swip.description: Reverse the meaning of left and right swipes.

settings.gestures.swipe_vertical_toleran.description: Allowed vertical finger travel, measured in trackpad coordinates. `0.4` and `40` both mean 40% of the trackpad height; smaller values require a straighter swipe.

settings.gestures.skip_empty.description: Skip workspaces with no windows when swiping.
settings.gestures.skip_empty.note: Omitting the entire `[settings.gestures]` table gives `true`; including the table but omitting this field gives `false`.

settings.gestures.fingers.description: Number of fingers required for a workspace swipe.

settings.gestures.distance_pct.description: Horizontal finger travel needed to switch workspaces, measured in trackpad coordinates. `0.08` is roughly 8% of the trackpad width. Rift clamps the value to `0.01`–`1.0`.

settings.gestures.haptics_enabled.description: Provide a tactile pulse when a workspace swipe is recognized.

settings.gestures.haptic_pattern.description: Pattern of tactile feedback used for workspace swipes.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.enabl.description: Enable horizontal swipes for moving between columns in a Scrolling workspace.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.inver.description: Reverse the meaning of left and right column swipes.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.verti.description: Allowed vertical finger movement while recognizing the start of a column scroll. Measured in trackpad coordinates: `0.4` and `40` both mean 40% of the trackpad height.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.finge.description: Number of fingers required for a column swipe.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.dista.description: Accumulated horizontal finger travel before Rift sends a scroll update, measured in trackpad coordinates. Smaller values send updates more often. Rift clamps the value to `0.01`–`1.0`.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.propa.description: After reaching the end of the column strip, continue the gesture into the adjacent virtual workspace.

settings.layout.scrolling.gestures.works.description: Overscroll, in normalized steps, required before the gesture switches workspaces.

settings.ui.stack_line.spacing.note: Omitting the entire containing table gives `0` instead.
settings.ui.stack_line.spacing.description: Distance from the window edge to the indicator, in macOS points.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.app_id.description: Application bundle ID, matched without regard to letter case. For example, `com.apple.Terminal`.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.workspace.description: Destination workspace name or zero-based index. Omit it to use the active workspace. Use a name from `workspace_names`.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.floating.description: Keep matching windows outside the tiled layout. A winning rule with this field omitted uses `false`; actions are not inherited from other rules.

virtual_workspaces.app_rules.manage.description: Set `false` to exclude matching windows from Rift. Set `true` to override the normal manageability checks for visible windows. Omit it to keep the normal checks. With `false`, omit placement and focus actions because they are ignored.

settings.layout.traditional.equalize_nod.description: Give a new window the average share of its siblings when inserting it. When false, split the selected window’s share instead. Manual resizing remains available.

settings.layout.scrolling.focus_navigati.description: Choose how horizontal focus reveals a column. `niri` scrolls only as needed in the navigation direction; `anchored` always places the focused column at the chosen `alignment`.

settings.layout.scrolling.alignment.description: Position used when aligning the focused column: left edge, center, or right edge. `focus_navigation_style` determines when that alignment is applied.
